data.name: Corpse Bond
data.description: An undead master can forge an arcane bond with an object, but that object must be made at least partially of bone. Alternatively, he can animate a corpse companion, as per the undead lord cleric archetype (Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Magic 32). He can't gain a familiar. This ability alters arcane bond.
